name: notion-bookmark
title: Raycast Notion Bookmark
description: Search and save bookmarks in Notion databases.
author: kuroweb

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Search selected Notion databases by title, URL, or tag and open the URL property.

commands.name: save-bookmark
commands.title: Save Bookmark
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Save a title, URL, tags, and page clip to a selected Notion database.

commands.name: configure-bookmark-databases
commands.title: Configure Bookmark Databases
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Choose which Notion databases to search.

commands.name: search-snippets
commands.title: Search Snippets
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Search selected Notion snippet databases by title, body, or tag and paste the page body.

commands.name: save-snippet
commands.title: Save Snippet
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Save a title, body, and tags to a selected Notion snippet database.

commands.name: configure-snippet-databases
commands.title: Configure Snippet Databases
commands.subtitle: Notion
commands.description: Choose which Notion snippet databases to search.

preferences.name: notionToken
preferences.title: Notion Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Personal access token from Notion developer tools (app.notion.com/developers). It uses your workspace permissions.
